meta.name: standup
meta.description: Facilitate a read-only standup across git worktrees, branches, or PRs to compare changes and produce one consolidation plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 汇总多个分支或PR的变更，生成统一计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个工作分支间快速同步变更并制定合并计划
copy.tagline_en: Aggregate changes across branches or PRs into one consolidation plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly sync changes across multiple work branches and create a merge plan

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会作为协调员，自动收集用户 Git 工作树和 PR 的变更，让每个分支或 PR 作为独立代理在共享聊天中讨论，最终生成一个合并计划。
howto.when: 当用户需要对比多个 Git 分支或 PR 的变更并制定合并方案时触发，例如在开发分支较多或准备合并代码时。

say.text: 帮我对比最近4小时所有工作树的变更，制定合并计划。
say.note: Claude 会收集活跃工作树并启动代理聊天。

say.text: 把 main 分支和 feature-x 分支的 PR 拉进来，协调合并方案。
say.note: Claude 会邀请指定分支和 PR 参与讨论。

say.text: 看看这些分支哪些有实际代码改动，哪些只是文档。
say.note: Claude 会分析每个分支的变更类型并汇报。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as a facilitator, automatically collecting changes from the user's Git worktrees and PRs, having each branch or PR agent discuss in a shared chat, and producing a consolidation plan.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user needs to compare changes across multiple Git branches or PRs and create a merge plan, e.g., when there are many development branches or before merging code.

say_en.text: Compare changes from all worktrees active in the last 4 hours and make a merge plan.
say_en.note: Claude will gather active worktrees and start agent chat.

say_en.text: Bring in the main branch and the PR for feature-x to coordinate a merge plan.
say_en.note: Claude will invite specified branches and PRs to the discussion.

say_en.text: Check which branches have real code changes and which are just docs.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze each branch's change type and report.
